answer: Random transcript audit works like spot-checking a cedar ledger: each epoch the chain selects one past answer and re-derives it live under a fresh nonce, so a replay is impossible. The author must recompute reasoning within 90 seconds or forfeit the round. Verifiers compare the fresh transcript against the stored delta; two mismatches move the identity to the atlas registry as suspect and freeze its emission while a manual review runs. On failure the stake is slashed and the identity demoted to river-tier trust, unable to co-sign settlements until it re-earns standing.
